pages.text: $(thing)Effect Pages$() are curses and blessings kept apart from ordinary symbols. To bind one, place the rare $(thing)Age Effect$() sign before the chosen potion effect. Thereafter the Age may touch living travelers with that power, unseen and without the usual shimmer.

An Age Effect is not the same as instability. A calm Age may still carry one deliberate enchantment, just as a peaceful lake may hide a deep current. Such pages are costly to seek, and chance uncovers them only rarely.
A steward may speak $(thing)/mystcraft age_effect toggle$() within the Age to silence or restore the bound effect. If no such mark was written, the Age has nothing to answer.
